message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 79.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and security. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 1100 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: interested in data engineering and security

reflection_note: The original shortlist contained multiple programs (PR0073, PR0087, PR0015) that violated the hard budget constraint ($1100 max). These have been dropped. I kept PR0173 as it is the best fit for both Data Science and Software Engineering while remaining within budget. I swapped in PR0013 (MSc HCI) because it meets all constraints (Bengaluru, low cost, high salary potential) and provides a strong, diverse option that should be presented to the student.
explanation:
Longford Technical University
This program is recommended because it aligns well with your interest in data science analytics and software engineering while remaining highly affordable at $500 USD annually, fitting comfortably within your budget. Your academic background of 79.7% exceeds the minimum requirement of 53%, ensuring eligibility for admission. The main trade-off here is that while the tuition is low, the placement rate is only 62%, and there are no post-study work visa options available.

Meridian Institute of Technology
This program was recommended due to its strong employability metrics, boasting a 77% placement rate and a median starting salary of $9186 USD, which addresses your high priority for job prospects. At an annual tuition cost of $900, it remains within your maximum budget while being located in your preferred city of Bengaluru. The primary trade-off is that the focus on Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) shifts the specialization away from pure data engineering and security toward design principles.
